messages:
megan: FYI staging->EU push got quarantined by publish checks. cosign verify failed (KMS key id mismatch). ccing @nate @oliver

deploy-bot: publish blocked for image: eu-ecr.redwood.com/service/staging:20240401-f4d2b1
reason: cosign verify FAILED (key id mismatch)
logs:
```
ERROR: verify: signature verification failed
expected key id: rk-2024-us
found key id: cust-legacy-01
```

nate: which process did the push? mirror-agent or build-bot?

megan: metadata shows mirror-agent-eu. layers identical, signature header different.

oliver: looking at mirror rollout notesthere was an env override today for customer mirror tests. possible COSIGN_KEY leak.

ivy: confirmed: mirror-agent-config had `COSIGN_KEY=/run/secrets/customer_cosign` applied to eu pool at 09:10.

megan: decision: HOLD promotion. do manual republish signed with canonical key (rk-2024-us). @release-manager hold EU change window.

nate: ops pin command: `k8s-image-promote --env=staging --image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/service@sha256:beefcafe --pin`

megan: manual republish plan:
1) pull by digest from central registry
2) tag locally and sign with release KMS key
3) push to eu-ecr and re-run deploybot checks

deploy-bot: queued manual re-sign job id=rb-2102; auto-publish suppressed until manual OK.

oliver: fallback if republish fails: label release `hold`, scale down canary, rollback to pinned digest, open INFRA ticket to prevent COSIGN_KEY overrides.

megan: republish done, cosign verify now passes:
```
VERIFIED: key id: rk-2024-us
status: OK
```

release-manager: holding GA for 2h observation window.

nate: filing INFRA-4721 to lock mirror config and add a preflight check to detect COSIGN_KEY env overrides. will update release notes.

deploy-bot: publish succeeded: image=eu-ecr.redwood.com/service@sha256:beefcafe; event=publish.complete; duration=98s

megan: adding a brief postmortem note to the release board.
